item.title: Beijing hits back at Anthropic CEO's call to curb China's AI development
item.description: China's Ministry of Foreign Affairs on Monday hit back at a call from the head of Anthropic for the U.S. to curb China's artificial intelligence capabilities.

item.title: Indonesia searches for 129 people missing after ferry capsizes in the Java Sea
item.description: Indonesian authorities intensified on Monday a search for people missing after a ferry overturned in bad weather in the Java Sea. At least six passengers were killed and 129 people are still missing.
item.content:encoded:
Indonesian authorities intensified on Monday a search for people missing after a ferry overturned in bad weather in the Java Sea. At least six passengers were killed and 129 people are still missing.

(Image credit: Iman Satria)

item.title: Russian drone hits train near Ukraine-Poland border soon after dignitaries passed through
item.description: A Russian drone struck a train near the Ukraine-Poland border shortly after senior visiting officials, including the former prime ministers of the U.K. and Sweden, passed through.

item.description: India hosted the an annual summit which gathered leaders from 28 countries, including the presidents of China and Iran. Though, the U.S. was notably absent.

item.title: Indonesian passenger ship overturns, sparking search for at least 129 missing
item.description: Indonesian rescuers said about 130 passengers and crew are missing after a ferry carrying more than 240 people sank in bad weather in the Java Sea on Sunday.

item.title: 'People are still afraid of those three letters': Fighting the stigma of HIV
item.description: That's a quote from former rugby star Gareth Thomas, who is HIV positive. At the International AIDS Conference in Rio this year, he spoke out about the isolation and discrimination tied to the virus.
